name: Comprehension Strategies for Tests
instructions: Read with a specific question in mind rather than passively taking in every word equally.
Underline or note key terms and claims as you go rather than waiting to reread everything at the end.
Practice recalling what you just read from memory before checking the text again -- retrieval strengthens retention more than rereading.
Watch today's video for test-oriented comprehension strategies (useful for any dense material, not just exams).
